note: An engine-generated 1830 game (lr1's generator, 2026-10-26, saved game ae28a30866eb4122b2437106d5a90cb0): three corporations of one president rotate one train at $1 (NYC buys PRR's last, C&O buys NYC's, PRR buys C&O's, ...), so none ever buys back from the corporation that bought its train and the buyback-only rule never fires. rotation_indices: the purchases of another corporation's last train by a corporation whose own last train another corporation bought before this turn, which the rule against train shuffling (BaseGame.no_buyback) forbids; the game replays as played (process_action accepts them).
